verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a candidate profile exists: applications require a CV, and manually added candidates show a header in their profile. The support site describes emailing candidates "all in one place," and there is an endpoint for adding profile fields to a candidate. Audit logs track candidate changes, including merges, which hints at one consolidated record per candidate. However, nothing shows these pieces actually come together in a single profile view. Missing for 10: evidence that email threads appear on the candidate profile, interview feedback or scorecards on the record, a per-candidate activity timeline, consent/GDPR status on the profile, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a unified profile.
